dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, serrated outer perimeters. High-contrast gradients transition abruptly from dark charcoal exterior pixels to high-intensity white/cream interiors. The most prominent structures show irregular, non-uniform thicknesses in their dark perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of amorphous, solid high-intensity white clusters concentrated primarily along the lower lateral and posterior regions. These clusters lack internal gradients or dark cores, appearing as irregular, solid-filled islands of high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal-central macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary geometric alignment consists of four smaller cluster centroids forming a roughly linear, diagonal axis extending from the mid-dorsal to the posterior-lateral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible localized area of pinkish-red tissue discoloration and irregular surface texture on the dorsal aspect of the rear-left flipper, indicative of a minor lesion or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique interlocking mosaic topology in the anterior-dorsal quadrant where multiple macro-annuli perimeters converge to form a continuous, chain-like network of high-contrast texture.
